name: Shuukan Kagura
source:
Betrayed by the ministry, 
Kagura the princess priestess is thrown in jail. 
Tomorrow morning in front of the people 
the worst of sentences will be carried out, 
and her only glimmer of hope, is you! 

Civilians, soldiers, animals, tentacles... 
Choose wrongly and disgrace will be instant. 
Can you safely rescue Kagura!? 

An ADV game of sex with a busty miko. 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE109402.html]DLsite English[/url]]
